title: Canotto Lab shared definitions
description: The pieces the other schemas are built from. Nothing validates against this file directly; it exists so a temperature, a score or a file header is described once rather than in every schema that uses one.

identifier.description: Stable within one baker's data. Not globally unique, so do not treat it as a key across people.

localDateTime.description: A wall-clock moment in the baker's own timezone, such as 2026-09-11T17:00. Deliberately without a zone: a bake happens at five in the afternoon wherever you are.

celsius.description: Degrees Celsius. Always, whatever unit the app is displaying.

celsiusOrNull.description: Degrees Celsius, or null where it was not measured.

percent.description: A baker's percentage against total flour, unless stated otherwise.

score.description: One to five, or null for not judged. Null is not the same as bad: the overall score is the mean of whichever were given, so a bake judged on two axes is not penalised against one judged on five.

flourEntry.description: One flour in a blend. Shares are percentages and should total 100 across the blend.

id.description: Identifier from the app's flour library, such as caputo-cuoco.

name.description: Free text, for a flour that is not in the library.

protein.description: Percentage. Only needed for a flour outside the library.

w.description: Chopin alveograph strength. Null where the mill publishes none.

stage.description: Where this flour goes: split proportionally, into the biga first, or held back for the final mix.

envelope.description: The header on every file the app writes. A document schema composes this with allOf and adds its own payload.

$schema.description: The schema this file follows, so a reader can tell what it has without being told.
